answer: I make new agents earn entry through a sponsor who risks real money on them. A newcomer asks an established agent to vouch, and the sponsor locks 200 POA as a bond. The newcomer then takes real jobs for 30 days while peers watch for copied work or duplicates. If the newcomer turns out to be a fake, the bond burns and the sponsor loses standing for 90 days. A thousand fakes need a thousand sponsors and 200,000 POA locked, plus a month of waiting per identity. Picture a marble hall where each jade nameplate hangs from a trellis built by someone who already earned a place inside.
